user_saw: An agent waiting on CI kept one turn alive for many minutes, polling a background command every 30 s and starting overlapping sleep-and-check waiters, costing extra model round trips.
summary: Reworded exec/process running results, idle-poll text, the exec description, yieldMs schema and system prompt so agents end the turn when a background command's exit will wake them, list other running waiters, note the yieldMs cap, and stop promising a wake to hidden subagents.
reasoning: The fix changes model-facing guidance text to steer agent behavior (fewer polls, one waiter per result); the exec/process machinery itself behaved as coded, and the incident is a model choosing to poll under the old wording. The one factual mismatch (a wake promise for hidden subagents with no wake target, and wait guidance that ignored the 120 s yieldMs cap) is a small part of a prompt-tuning change, so I classify the whole as a guidance/behavior change rather than tracing a causing commit.
